holdout_coverage_note: 2026 source is currently documented through 2026-08-14, so final holdout is partial-year/YTD unless a later raw file replaces it.

rationale.2025: Fabio V4 scanner and Single-Year Diagnostic were already centered on 2025, so it cannot honestly be called untouched OOS.
rationale.2024: Use as external validation for the frozen 2025-developed generation; do not optimize pooled 2024+2025 parameters.
rationale.2026: Reserve Fabio outcomes for one-time final holdout evaluation after discovery/validation rules and production candidate are frozen.

rules: Never optimize parameters on discovery+validation+holdout pooled data.
Do not inspect 2026 Fabio outcome tables before the production candidate/rules are frozen if 2026 is to retain final-holdout meaning.
Any material scanner/node/parameter change after seeing 2026 Fabio outcomes creates a new strategy generation and invalidates 2026 as final OOS for that generation.
Multi-Year Edge Map used for production-node selection must default to discovery+validation only before final holdout.
After final holdout is revealed, an all-years report is descriptive evidence, not a new optimization dataset.
Synthetic QA remains software validation only.
